com.wac.autocore.util

Class Resources

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.wac.autocore.util.Resources

  • public final class Resources
extends java.lang.Object
    Reads the files that follow the program: themes, texts and the sample data. They are on the classpath, so it does not matter where the program is started from.
